detail.longDescription:
Meet PotatoAI WebUI!

I got tired of juggling CLI commands for my local AI tools, so I vibecoded my own browser interface using OpenCode and MiMo-V2.6-Flash-Free. 

It currently brings together:

- Whisper.cpp for speech-to-text  
- Audio.cpp for text-to-speech and voice cloning  
- Llama.cpp with GLM-OCR for OCR and experimental image description

Instead of relying on traditional OCR engines like EasyOCR, I'm using a multimodal LLM for OCR. My old Core i5-650 lacks AVX support, which can be a problem for CPU-based OCR setups and their dependencies. By running GLM-OCR on the GPU through Vulkan, I can work around this limitation without upgrading my hardware. Image description is still experimental, but OCR already works with this approach.

Everything runs locally on my system using Vulkan. No cloud APIs, no subscriptions!

Every task displays its exact CLI command, which I can copy, export as a shell script, or edit before execution. Live output and a job queue make the whole workflow much more convenient.

And this might just be the beginning. I'm considering merging it with my existing PotatoDiffusion project to create one interface for all my local AI tools.

All running on a Core i5-650 from 2010, 8 GB of DDR3 RAM and an AMD RX 570 with just 4 GB of VRAM.
